units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 2:1:8">Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵃ</cite> top <he>דהוון אילין מַסְּבִין יומא דין וכ׳</he> these went around (as messengers to announce the New-Moon) to-day, and others the day after.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 2:1:8">Ib.</cite> <he>מהו דיַסְּבוּן</he>; <he>למה מַסְּבָה</he>, v. <cite ref="R00722"><he>צְפַת</he></cite>.
